draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield for Orchard Ventures
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Following up on our onboarding call last week -- I know getting started alongside everything else is easy to put off. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one project is usually all it takes to see how your team's work maps over. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 20-minute call this week help? I'm glad to set up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
